title: Resonant Microstructures as Dirac-type Sources for Acoustic Wave Control
summary: We study finite-time acoustic wave tracking using effective interior Dirac-type actuators generated by clusters of subwavelength resonant bubbles driven from exterior transducers. Starting from a time-domain point-interaction approximation, the full scattering problem is reduced to a finite-dimensional delayed system of interacting retarded monopoles. After localization to a bounded observation domain, we formulate the tracking problem on a prescribed finite-dimensional Dirichlet spectral subspace.
